title: mediatype.get
description: Retrieve media types according to the given parameters.

mediatypeids.description: Return only media types with the given IDs.

mediaids.description: Return only media types used by the given media.

userids.description: Return only media types used by the given users.

selectMessageTemplates.description: Return a message_templates property with an array of media type messages. Since Zabbix 6.0.34, this parameter is supported only for Super admin type users.

selectUsers.description: Return a users property with the users that use the media type. See user.get for restrictions based on user type.

sortfield.description: Sort the result by the given properties. Possible values are: mediatypeid.

filter.description: Return only those results that exactly match the given filter. Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are either a single value or an array of values to match against. Does not support properties of text data type. Possible Media type object properties for Admin type users (since Zabbix 6.0.34): mediatypeid, name, type, status, maxattempts.

output.description: Media type object properties to be returned. Since Zabbix 6.0.34, Admin type users may retrieve only the following properties: mediatypeid, name, type, status, maxattempts, description. Default: extend.

search.description: Return results that match the given pattern (case-insensitive). Accepts an object, where the keys are property names, and the values are strings to search for. Supports only properties of string and text data type. Possible Media type object properties for Admin type users (since Zabbix 6.0.34): name, description.

countOutput.description: Return the number of records in the result instead of the actual data.

editable.description: If set to true, return only objects that the user has write permissions to. Default: false.

excludeSearch.description: Return results that do not match the criteria given in the search parameter.

limit.description: Limit the number of records returned.

preservekeys.description: Use IDs as keys in the resulting array.

searchByAny.description: If true, return results that match any of the criteria given in the filter or search parameter. Default: false.

searchWildcardsEnabled.description: If true, enables the use of '*' as a wildcard character. Default: false.

sortorder.description: Order of sorting. ASC or DESC.

startSearch.description: The search parameter will compare the beginning of fields. Ignored if searchWildcardsEnabled is set.
